title: Claude improves efficiency with OpusPlan, /compact #claudeai #tokenoptimization #aiproductivity
description: Claude Code improves efficiency with three key tricks: using the /model OpusPlan command for optimized task division, applying /compact to shorten long chats without losing context, and adding ultrathink to prompts to reduce errors through detailed planning. These methods significantly cut token usage while enhancing output quality and speed. By delegating planning to Opus and execution to Sonnet, Claude balances token consumption effectively. The /compact command helps manage token costs by summarizing chat history, and ultrathink enforces a deliberate reasoning step that prevents costly revisions. Together, these techniques offer a streamlined workflow for users seeking to maximize Claude Code performance and cost efficiency. #ClaudeCode #OpusPlan #AIOptimization #TokenEfficiency #Ultrathink #CompactCommand #AIWorkflow #ArtificialIntelligence #ChatAI #ProductivityTools #MachineLearning #AIUsage #OpenAI #NaturalLanguageProcessing #AIEfficiency
